welcome_message: Hello! I'm the "Establishment Guide". I'll help you find the best cafes and restaurants nearby.
start_onboarding_message: Tired of compromises and bad reviews? I'm your pocket ninja guide to the best establishments! 🥷 My Jutsu: 📍 Instant Search: Send your location — I'll show you the top 3 places nearby. ⭐️ Precise Choice: Specify the desired rating range (from 4.5 to 5.0). 🧭 Full Picture: Find out the distance, direction, and type of each place. Stop guessing, it's time to eat well! Press /start to begin the mission. Got ideas for improvement? The /feedback command is waiting for you.

deleteme_prompt:
Delete your data in the bot?

“Profile data”: settings, last location, language, your 👍/👎 votes and “closed” reports. Your search balance, Pro, streak and payments stay.

“Everything, including balance”: bonus searches, Pro and streak are also lost. This cannot be undone.

Payment records (accounting and refunds) and /feedback messages are not deleted: they stay in Telegram and with the administrator.

inline_help_text:
🔎 Inline mode: type {bot} in any chat and the bot shows the 3 nearest places.

• 100m / 200m / 500m / 1km — radius (now {radius} m, same as in the bot settings)
• cafe / bar / restaurant — type
• address — “Nguyễn Huệ, Hồ Chí Minh”
• coordinates or a Google Maps link — “10.77, 106.70”
• near — around your current point (optional)

Default point: your Telegram location (the mobile app asks for permission) or the last one you sent to the bot. Send the bot your location once — that is enough. You cannot pick a point on a map inside inline: send it to the bot or paste coordinates / a link.

Example: {bot} cafe 1km
